Messages.Author: Khaleph Alendis
Messages.Body:
During my minion phase the number of counters on a temptation card
equals or exceeds the amount of blood on the target vampire. (Emerson
Bridges for this example)
So, i burn all the counters on this card to untap Emerson Bridges and
take control of him until the end of my turn.

During that turn, i use Emerson Bridges to bleed and play a Day
Operation. So, the poor ventrue is in torpor after the bleed.

My question is :

Where Emerson Bridges go after the end of my turn ?
He stay in my torpor and is mine or he go in my prey torpor ?

And the same question can be asked for Mind Rape.

-- Richard Labrecque
